video_goal: Demonstrate the precise technique of gathering a starter bubble of molten glass from a furnace using a steel blowpipe.
required_subjects_and_props: Glassblower, long steel blowpipe, roaring glass furnace with crucible, glowing molten glass, metal yoke stand.

outline_steps.visual_action: The glassblower holds the long steel blowpipe horizontally, resting the tip just inside the roaring furnace opening.
The tip of the steel blowpipe glows dull red as the glassblower's hands rotate the metal shaft slowly.
The glassblower steps forward, pushing the blowpipe deeper into the bright orange, glowing furnace crucible.
The blowpipe tip hovers just above the flat, glowing pool of molten glass inside the crucible.
The steel tip dips downward, breaking the surface of the bright orange molten glass.
The glassblower's bare hands rapidly twist the shaft of the blowpipe, spinning it continuously in a clockwise direction.
The glowing orange molten glass spools thickly around the spinning blowpipe tip, resembling honey wrapping around a dipper.
The glassblower slightly raises the angle of the blowpipe, lifting the gathered glass out of the pool while maintaining the continuous spinning motion.
The glassblower slowly pulls the blowpipe backward toward the furnace door, keeping the shaft rotating.
A thin, glowing thread of molten glass stretches from the pool and snaps off as the gather clears the crucible edge.
The glassblower fully extracts the blowpipe from the furnace, revealing a glowing, bulbous gather of glass on the end.
The glassblower rests the pipe on a metal yoke stand, continuously rolling the shaft back and forth to keep the glowing molten glass perfectly centered.
